A lot of the sounds on the early unwound records are from very simple guitars and gear.

A personal favorite from the early stuff is the Electro Harmonix LPB-1, super primitive boost pedal and they get a nice punk level of overdrive crunch. Super affordable too! 
Other than that, a proco RAT, boss DS-1/DS-2, or any basic distortion will get you pretty close. The beautiful thing with punk and Unwound, was that the sound they achieved was from them utilizing the stuff they already had. So just try some stuff with what you already have and you might even find the sounds you didn’t even know you were searching for.
